note: Alerts: official notices a student can act on, each tied to a route in data/routes (which holds the full verbatim requirements and the Gazette source). Eligibility fields restate the quoted rule so the phone can check it; the quote is verbatim from the route's requirements text (checked by tools/rulebook/check-journey.ts). O/L rules are shown, never checked: ZedPath does not hold O/L results.

notices.title: Inspector of Customs, Grade II: open competitive exam

age.quote: is not less than 18 years and not more than 24 years of age to the closing date of applications

al.quote: Should have passed three main subjects at the GCE (A/L) examination in one sitting

notices.ol: Six O/L passes with five credits, including Sinhala or Tamil and Mathematics, and at least a pass in English

notices.title: National Diploma in Technology, University of Moratuwa

age.quote: Applicants should be below 24 years of age on 31.12.2025

al.quote: Applicants should have obtained passes for following three (03) subjects: (i) Physics (ii) Chemistry (iii) Combined Mathematics or Higher Mathematics at one and the same sitting

notices.ol: Marine Engineering Technology and Nautical Studies also need a credit (C) in English at O/L

notices.title: Electrician (Special) apprenticeship, NAITA IETI Moratuwa

age.quote: Candidates must be between 16 and 35 years of age as of 31.12.2026

notices.ol: Six O/L passes including Sinhala, Science and Mathematics (with a credit in Mathematics or Science), or two A/L passes including Science or a technology subject with the O/L passes

notices.title: ICT Technician apprenticeship, NAITA IETI Moratuwa

age.quote: Candidates must be between 16 and 35 years of age as of 31.12.2026

notices.ol: Six O/L passes including Sinhala and Mathematics, a pass in English (O/L or A/L) and a basic computer course

notices.title: Management Service Officers, Grade III: open competitive exam

age.quote: Shall be not less than 18 years and not more than 30 years of age as at the closing date of applications

al.quote: Shall have passed all the subjects in General Certificate of Education (Advanced Level) at one sitting

notices.ol: Six O/L passes with four credits, including a language and Mathematics, at one sitting

notices.title: Bachelor of Software Engineering, Open University of Sri Lanka

al.quote: Passes in any three subjects at the General Certificate of Education (Advanced Level) excluding General English and General Information Technology subjects
